drivingQuestion: May a needle whose eye or point was removed be moved on Shabbat?
outcomeNote: Rav Yosef's answer follows in shabbat.sugya719.

segments.he: מַחַט שֶׁל יָד לִיטּוֹל בָּהּ כּוּ׳. שְׁלַח לֵיהּ רָבָא בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַבָּה לְרַב יוֹסֵף: יְלַמְּדֵנוּ רַבֵּינוּ, מַחַט שֶׁנִּיטַּל חֲרָרָהּ אוֹ עוּקְצָהּ, מַהוּ?
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: One is permitted to take «an» ordinary «hand needle» used for sewing clothes «to extract» a thorn «with it. Rava, son of Rabba, sent» the following question «to Rav Yosef: Let our teacher teach us:» With regard to a «needle whose eye or point was removed, what is its» legal status, i.e., is moving it on Shabbat permitted?
